hosting.//: Pinned to its own site. Without this both this config and the root firebase.json deployed to odo-mobile-ba9aa, so whichever ran last replaced the other — that is how the legal pages became 404 while the store listing pointed at them. odoapp.in maps here; legal.odoapp.in maps to the root config's site.
hosting.//redirects: The documents' own nav links relatively to `delete-account`, and web/build.ts writes the page here as `delete.html` because /legal/delete is the path we publish. Without this the header on the privacy page 404s.
hosting.//headers: One entry per path, repetitive on purpose, and the same rule the root config learned: sources must not overlap. A '**' rule alongside the '/legal/delete' one wins over it whichever order they are in, which puts the documents' script-less policy on the one page that runs scripts and breaks account deletion silently. The image globs below match only .png and .svg, so they cannot collide with these three.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline' https://*.gstatic.com https://*.google.com https://*.googleapis.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co https://*.googleapis.com https://*.google.com https://*.gstatic.com; frame-src https://*.google.com https://*.firebaseapp.com; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: https://*.gstatic.com https://*.google.com; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

hosting.//blog: The Compose/Wasm app in :webApp. Two rewrites because Firebase matches them literally: '/blog/**' does not cover the bare '/blog'. Static files win over a rewrite, so /blog/odo-blog.js still serves the bundle and only unmatched paths fall through to the app.
